Not a jurisdiction -- logging the tooling fix found/applied during this IL pass since every state's Flash discovery step depends on it. response_mime_type='application/json' combined with the google_search tool silently corrupts Gemini 3.5 Flash's output (confirmed live: returned literal garbage '{}"}end}' instead of raising) -- every prior county that fell through to Flash and came back with a parse error (not just IL; this bug predates this session) was hitting this. Separately, even without that flag, multi-part responses (a reasoning preamble + the real final JSON as a separate part) were naively concatenated before JSON extraction, which spans the regex match across part boundaries and produces garbled text. Fixed both: dropped response_mime_type entirely when google_search is enabled, and added extract_json_blob_from_parts() to try each part independently (last-to-first) before falling back to concatenation.
